claims.quote: You can get help from NHS 111: by using 111 online in the NHS App
claims.note: The page explicitly offers the online route.

claims.claim: You can use NHS 111 by phone.
claims.quote: You can get help from NHS 111: by using 111 online in the NHS App by calling 111

claims.claim: NHS 111 gives urgent medical advice online or by phone when help is needed now.
claims.quote: NHS 111 can help if you think you need medical help right now. You can get help from NHS 111: by using 111 online in the NHS App by calling 111
claims.note: The page states both urgent need and both routes.

claims.claim: NHS 111 is for situations that are not 999 emergencies.
claims.quote: call 999 or go to A&E in an emergency
claims.note: The page directs emergencies to 999 or A&E.

claims.claim: NHS 111 assesses symptoms and directs people to an appropriate service.
claims.quote: Answer questions about your symptoms on the website or in the NHS App and you will be told what to do next.
claims.note: The page describes symptom questions and next-step advice.
